summary: American Healthcare REIT filed an 8-K reporting entry into a new ATM Equity Offering Sales Agreement with ten agents and forward purchasers for up to $1.75 billion aggregate gross sales price of common stock, replacing the prior February 2026 ATM under which roughly $170.1 million remained unsold. Sales occur at prevailing market prices via ordinary brokers' transactions, block trades, or forward-sale mechanics, with no stated price, premium, or closing date. This is a routine shelf/ATM takedown capacity arrangement, not a special situation; watch dilution and forward-sale overhang relative to equity capital needs.
